questions.stem: Why might some people have ethical concerns about IVF treatment?

options.text: Because unused embryos may be destroyed, which raises moral questions about when life begins
Because it only works for people under 25
Because it is a completely risk-free procedure

questions.explanation: IVF often produces more embryos than are needed. Unused embryos may be stored, donated, or destroyed, which raises ethical concerns for some people about the status and rights of embryos.
